record.original_question: Let G be a minor-closed class of graphs that excludes K_{3,t} for some positive integer t. Does there exist a threshold Delta_0 such that every graph G in this class with Delta(G) > Delta_0 satisfies both chi(G^2) <= chi_l(G^2) and chi_l(G^2) <= floor(3 Delta(G) / 2) + 1?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 9 ([91]). If G is a nice class of graphs, then there exists ∆0 such that if G ∈ G and ∆(G) > ∆0, then χ2(G) 6 χ2_ℓ(G) 6 floor(3∆(G)/2) + 1.

If G is a minor-closed class of graphs that excludes K3,t for some integer t, then there exists ∆0 such that if G ∈ G and ∆(G) > ∆0, then χ2(G) 6 χ2_ℓ(G) 6 floor(3∆(G)/2) + 1. This is Conjecture 9, due to Havet, van den Heuvel, McDiarmid, and Reed.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a graph $G$, let $G^2$ denote the square of $G$, i.e. the graph on $V(G)$ in which two distinct vertices are adjacent if and only if their distance in $G$ is at most $2$. Write $\Delta(G)$ for the maximum degree of $G$, $\chi(H)$ for the chromatic number of $H$, and $\chi_\ell(H)$ for the list chromatic (choice) number of $H$. A class $\mathcal{G}$ of graphs is minor-closed if every minor of every member of $\mathcal{G}$ belongs to $\mathcal{G}$.

Prove or disprove the following: For every minor-closed class $\mathcal{G}$ of graphs that excludes $K_{3,t}$ as a minor for some positive integer $t$, there exists a constant $\Delta_0 = \Delta_0(\mathcal{G})$ such that every graph $G \in \mathcal{G}$ with $\Delta(G) > \Delta_0$ satisfies
$$\chi(G^2) \le \chi_\ell(G^2) \le \left\lfloor \tfrac{3\Delta(G)}{2} \right\rfloor + 1.$$
artifact.category_tag: graph coloring (square and list chromatic number)
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture, due to Havet, van den Heuvel, McDiarmid, and Reed, extends Wegner's conjecture and asymptotic results of Havet–van den Heuvel–McDiarmid–Reed (who proved the upper bound (3/2)Δ(1+o(1)) for planar graphs and certain minor-closed classes). For special subclasses such as K_4-minor-free graphs the bound ⌊3Δ/2⌋+1 is known, but for the general K_{3,t}-minor-free minor-closed setting the conjecture is not reported as resolved in the surveys and follow-up literature found.

status_evidence.title: List Colouring Squares of Planar Graphs (Havet, van den Heuvel, McDiarmid, Reed)
status_evidence.snippet: Shows the square list chromatic number is at most (3/2)Δ(1+o(1)) for planar graphs and more general classes, motivating the stated conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Asymptotic version is known; exact ⌊3Δ/2⌋+1 bound conjectured.

status_evidence.title: A unified approach to distance-two colouring of graphs on surfaces
status_evidence.snippet: Distance-two colouring results for graphs embeddable on surfaces, related to the conjectured ⌊3Δ/2⌋+1 bound.
status_evidence.claim: Partial / asymptotic progress, exact conjecture not established.

status_evidence.title: Coloring the square of a K4-minor-free graph
status_evidence.snippet: For K_4-minor-free graphs with Δ≥4, χ(G^2) ≤ ⌊3Δ/2⌋+1.
status_evidence.claim: Known for the special subclass K_4-minor-free, supporting but not resolving the general K_{3,t}-minor-free conjecture.
